6531223.name: Chabad of Babcock Ranch - Charlotte County
6531223.note: CrownHeights.info, 4 Dec 2024 ('Chabad Responds to Tragedy by Expanding Global Outreach: 100 New Centers To Be Established'): Keren Hashluchim seed funding 'for one hundred new Chabad centers in underserved areas'; among 'The Fifty New Shluchim': 'Rabbi Mendel and Malky Jacobson at Chabad of Babcock Ranch, FL' (a new community Chabad House). Its chabad.org listing went up 1 Oct 2024; IRS (ProPublica): 'Chabad Of Babcock Ranch - Charlotte County Inc', care of Menachem Mendel Jacobson, exempt from 2025-06.
